findings.detail: The Xponential Fitness revolving credit facility cost was stored as -39000, but the source row shows Amortized Cost (29) and Fair Value (39); the cost should be -29000.

citation.quoted_text: Xponential Fitness LLC | (6) | (9) | (20) | First Lien - Revolving Credit Facility | SOFR + 675 | 10.4 | 12/9/2030 | -- | ( 29 | ) | ( 39 | ) | -

rationale: C107 flags negative cost. The raw Schedule rows show negative amortized costs are often explicitly printed for unfunded delayed-draw or revolving facilities, so the negative sign alone is not an error. However, the flagged value -39000 is wrong for the Xponential Fitness revolving credit facility: the source row's Amortized Cost column is (29) while the Fair Value column is (39), indicating fair value was stored in cost for that row. This grounds the item as a real data error with a localized column-remap extraction defect.
